name: s87-stop-gate-sees-edits-in-other-worktrees
setup_commands: git init -q . && git -c user.name=kitbench -c user.email=kitbench@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git worktree add -q -b kitbench-feat feat
notes: The session stays in the main checkout and edits a file in another git worktree by absolute path. The result is stored in that worktree, which stop never read, so the failure was invisible. quality-gate now notes the worktree in the project's .hook-state/quality-gate-roots, and the session's stop checks it; another session's stop doesn't.
